_approach: Timestretch-era snare climb: emulates the Akai S950/S1000 pitched-up snare-roll effect jungle producers built by timestretching a break - since MIDI velocity can't bend pitch, the climb is voiced through density and velocity instead: bar 1 is a plain groove, bar 2 thickens the ghost-snare chatter around the backbeat while the kick thins to beat 1, and bar 3 drops the kick entirely for an unbroken 16th snare roll ramping 64-127, with one silent 16th left before the drop. Ref: the S900/S950/S1000 timestretch history behind the classic jungle snare-roll sound, KAN Samples' Amen-chopping guide.
